nodes.label: Compute Express Link (CXL) 3.1 Coherent Memory Architecture Protocol
nodes.description: Cache-coherent interconnect standard over PCIe 6.0 supporting fabric switching, dynamic capacity sharing, and multi-host memory pooling across heterogeneous AI accelerators.

nodes.label: Falcon-512 Fast Fourier Lattice-Based Digital Signature Algorithm
nodes.description: Post-quantum digital signature algorithm based on NTRU lattices using Fast Fourier Sampling, optimizing signature verification speed and bandwidth overhead.

nodes.label: Roaring Bitmap Compressed Bitset High-Performance Indexing Engine
nodes.description: Container-based sparse bitmap compression scheme partitioning 32-bit integers into 16-bit chunks, optimizing fast set intersection and union operations for graph traversal.

nodes.label: W3C TriG Extension to Turtle for Expressing Named RDF Datasets
nodes.description: W3C Recommendation syntax extending Turtle to allow grouping of RDF triple statements into discrete named graphs within a single dataset serialization.

nodes.label: Prague Arabic Dependency Treebank (PADT) Morpho-Syntactic Standard
nodes.description: Standardized linguistic annotation framework providing functional dependency structures, case assignment, and morphological disambiguation for Semitic graph parsing.
